title: Studio designers: a refused save marks no field row in a type's registered default inspector (view, object, ...), because ResourceEditPage passes it no issues (follow-up of #35499)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUjtFEFN5FLe377MBT

Filing gate: ② seat-directed. Out-of-scope finding (class a) from the #35499 dev's report on PR #35623 (comment 7018192154); seat repo:objectstack#1 asked this thread to file it. Same mechanism as #35499 (where a refused save's issues are drawn); after #35623 merges, the #35499 card thread takes it in series. ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets lane and grade.

## What the author sees

After a refused metadata save, a type whose editor is a registered default inspector (the view designer's `ViewVariantInspector`, the object designer's `ObjectDefaultInspector`, and any other type registered in `default-inspector-registry.ts`) draws the cause under no field row. #35623 makes `SchemaForm` draw a nested cause (`label.not_a_locale`, `config.columns.0`) under the row its path names, but these inspectors render their own forms and are never handed the issues, so that fix does not reach them. Measured by the #35499 dev against a running console: a view save refused at `label.not_a_locale` (two entries, `invalid_key` and `invalid_format`) and at `config.columns.0` (`unrecognized_keys`) lights no row in the view designer. The cause is still in the Save button's reason and, for types with a live validator, in the banner. Not driven through a refused save in the view designer UI end to end: the serving shapes came from `PUT /api/v1/meta/view`, the mounted rows from the running console.

## Where (read at `e35cf035`)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx:3776-3796`: with no selection, the registered `DefaultInspectorComponent` gets `type`, `name`, `draft`, `onPatch`, `onSelectionChange`, `onBlockingIssuesChange`, `readOnly`, `locale`, `serverSchema`; no `issues` and no inline-register callback. The flat `SchemaForm` fallback right below it does get `issues={displayIssues}` (`:3792`, `:3822`).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ViewVariantInspector.tsx:527-534`: its `SchemaForm` gets no `issues` and no `onInlineIssueFieldsChange`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectDefaultInspector.tsx`: replaces the form for objects; takes no issues.
- `default-inspector-registry.ts:86-98`: the registry, so the gap applies to every registered type, not only view and object.

## Fix direction (to be designed on the card)

Hand the inspectors the same `displayIssues` and the inline register, so the #35623 placement rule applies inside them and the banner keeps leaving out what a row draws (objectstack#27865, one message per mistake). A view variant's paths are relative to the variant, so a prefix trim like `EmbeddedItemEditor`'s may be needed. Which inspectors draw rows from a `SchemaForm` and which from bespoke controls is to be measured.

Evidence: os-dev report 7018192154 on PR #35623 (`summary`, zone-2 measurement (2), and `out_of_scope_findings`); screenshots in the project folder `build-seat1/35499/`.

Dedupe: issue search `view designer refused save no row highlighted` → 2 (QA run records #23166, #25817, closed, not this); `ViewVariantInspector SchemaForm issues` → 1 (#27895, closed, a different inspector feature); `default inspector refusal issues` → 133, first 30 read, none about issues reaching a default inspector.
